name: dsh-duplicate-file-check
description: Duplicate file checker for DSH: exact duplicates (size + head/middle/tail sampling or full byte compare), near-duplicate MP4 detection by duration and first-10s frame similarity, batch rename (extension / UUID / by size / by video duration), and unified encoding of MOV/AVI/WMV to MP4 detected by file header. Concurrent execution, smart copy, HDR modes, hardware encoders.
